text:
Which statement about electric current in a conductor is correct?
A
In a d.c. circuit, the electric current gradually decreases along the conductor.
B
In a d.c. circuit, the free electrons flow back and forth.
C
In an a.c. circuit, the electric current remains exactly the same all the time.
D
In an a.c. circuit, the flow of charge changes direction continually.

options.label: A
options.text: In a d.c. circuit, the electric current gradually decreases along the conductor.

options.label: B
options.text: In a d.c. circuit, the free electrons flow back and forth.

options.label: C
options.text: In an a.c. circuit, the electric current remains exactly the same all the time.

options.label: D
options.text: In an a.c. circuit, the flow of charge changes direction continually.
